name: cust_wide
journey: The head shrine of Inari, the kami of rice and good fortune. Around 10,000 vermilion torii gates climb Mount Inari in long tunnels.
Foxes (kitsune) are Inari's messengers, so fox statues guard the shrine, often with a key or a jewel in their mouths.
Home! Every journey of mine starts here~
Japan's first permanent capital, from 710. Over a thousand wild sika deer roam Nara Park, and Tōdai-ji houses a bronze Great Buddha about 15 m tall.
The deer are seen as messengers of the gods, and many bow back if you bow to them.
They bow if you bow! Very polite... until you have crackers.

opts.text: Her coat, eyes, foxfire, outfits, voice and little habits. Changes show up right away.
Try a mood (or click her: head, nose, belly and tails all react differently)
How much fox-girl talk (kon kon~, ehehe~)
How she reacts when you slack
Little voice clips on her reactions (kon kon~, ehehe~, kyuu~, mou~!)
Open VOICEVOX by itself when Zenko starts (hidden)
With VOICEVOX, she says each speech bubble out loud in Japanese (the bubble stays in English)
Her sounds are only her voice now: no drums, bells or plucks. Without VOICEVOX she uses her little built-in voice clips; pick Off above for silence.
Engine: not found yet (she looks in your voicevox_engine folder and the VOICEVOX app's folder)
Talking voice (when she reads her replies out loud)
Her chirps are made inside the app (no recordings of real people). VOICEVOX voices are free; credit 'VOICEVOX:<character>' if you share them.
Fur colour (the app theme stays the same)
A zenko earns a new tail with wisdom
Big sleepy yawns now and then
Curls up and sleeps when I'm away
You've studied 0.0 hours with her so far.
Dress for the season (auto)  (unlocks at 3 h)
Seasonal kimono, a yukata for summer festivals, the uniform when exams are near
Sakura, ro silk, momiji or snow, following the calendar
Indigo with morning glories and a yellow obi
Stretches, play bows, naps and pounces now and then
Tick what shows in the sidebar and use the arrows to reorder. Hidden pages are still one Ctrl+K search away.

Foxfire  (reach Village of Nine Tails, 450 h)
Bubble grows and shrinks with her size
